about: How the game starts. Kept apart from the data: no thing or field knows it is the start, so this can change without touching either.

next_board.about: Where the button that ends a set leads (the owner's rulings of 23 and 24 Nov 2026). deeper_share of the time: the best line he has shown, that is, the set inside the group he did best (no wrong guess that took in its things, no clue; ties go to the group he attempted earliest). The rest of the time: a set he has not proven.

web.about: The web of what he has found. After after_sets sets in one sitting it opens by itself, if it has grown, and the new knots light up one by one (the owner, 24 Nov 2026: 'your web grew'). 0: never by itself; the button at the top still opens it.
